If you've been out of the VR scene for a minute, you might not realize just how many competitive standalone headsets there are nowadays. Between the highly sought-after Valve Steam Frame, the recently announced Meta VR Glasses, and the lineup of Meta Quest headsets, there's quite a spectrum to choose from depending on your needs.

The Meta Quest 3S, released in 2024, is still the latest headset from Meta, taking over as the new entry-level headset following the discontinuation of the Meta Quest 2. It's a great option if you're looking to get into VR, or want to upgrade an old headset. Even better, it's currently on sale for 15% off the regular price as part of Amazon's Black Friday sale. Check out the full rundown below for more details.

Meta Quest 3S Bundle for $297

The Meta Quest 3S is a blend between the current flagship Meta Quest 3 and the previous generation Meta Quest 2, offering a great entry into VR for just about anyone. The Quest 3S features the same Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 chip with 8GB RAM as the Quest 3, allowing you to play any modern VR game without issues.

As a way to reduce the overall cost a bit, the Quest 3S features a lower resolution display (the same as the Quest 2, in fact) and uses the older Fresnel lenses, which make the headset slightly bulkier than that of the Quest 3. However, it does allow for full-color passthrough, making this a great mixed reality headset.

While Meta has a number of Black Friday bundles available for the Quest 3S, the absolute lowest price option available is $297 for the 128GB model, which also includes Golf+ (a $30 value) and 1,800 in-game credits (a $10 value) which can be used to purchase additional courses. This deal is available now through November 30 and is likely the best discount we'll see for the rest of 2026.
